criteria.text: I can repeat `pdd test` without changing my files and see unchanged Stories with their previous pass time, zero current AI calls and the number of skipped Stories.
Changing a reached prompt, shared dependency, starting data, test or Story reruns exactly the affected Stories in my selected scope; unrelated Stories stay skipped.
A Story is reused only after all its test files passed; failed, refused, not-run, unknown or interrupted attempts cannot reuse an older pass.
`pdd test --lf` runs the latest failed Stories in my selected scope; no history runs the selected Stories and known history with no failures runs none.
`pdd test --cache-clear` clears the whole cache and runs all Stories, even when a path or `--lf` is also supplied.
A damaged or unsafe cache runs my selected Stories with one warning, leaves outside files untouched and never treats damaged data as a pass.
The local `.pdd/test-cache/` folder is Git-ignored in my repository, including a linked worktree.
I can select tests by Story, test file, Story file or directory relative to my current folder; ordinary test and its accepted former name use the same cache.
